member.name: M:bolt.module.paportal.PortalDataImporter.ThrowIfBlockedExtensionsInPayload
member.summary: Aborts the upload (both `pages upload` and `pages upload-code-site`) when the customer's data contains any file whose extension is blocked by the environment. Called after the payload is enumerated and before any records or file content are pushed, so nothing is uploaded.

member.name: M:bolt.module.paportal.PortalDataImporter.ThrowIfBlockedMimeTypesInPayload
member.summary:
Aborts the upload when the customer's data contains a file whose (extension-inferred) MIME type is blocked by the environment's blocked MIME types.
Applies ONLY to the adx (SDM) path. There, web-file binary content is uploaded as annotation records that carry a MIME type the server validates against organization.blockedmimetypes, so a blocked MIME type fails mid-upload today. On the core (EDM) path the same content is written to the `filecontent` column, which the server does NOT screen by MIME type -- it accepts e.g. .svg there. Preflighting MIME on the core path would therefore over-block files the server would actually accept, so it is intentionally skipped. Extension blocks, which the server enforces uniformly, are handled separately in for both paths.
